rounds.text: D.K. Enterprises Global Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, with a margin of safety calculated at 78.6% [E42]. The company demonstrates superior capital efficiency compared to its peers, evidenced by an ROE of 18.87% and an ROCE of 20.19%, both of which comfortably outperform their respective sector benchmarks of 10.87% and 12.93% [E9, E10]. This operational strength is further supported by a valuation that is deeply compressed, with a P/E ratio of 8.3x against a sector benchmark of 22.4x and an EV/EBITDA of 5.56x compared to the sector's 12.66x [E6, E11]. The business has maintained a robust long-term growth trajectory, achieving compounded sales and profit growth of 21% and 18% respectively over the last five years [E14, E17]. Conceded: the company faces recent headwinds including a deceleration in profit growth to 1% over the trailing twelve months [E19], a decline in share price performance [E20, E21], and an increase in borrowings from Rs 10 Cr to Rs 20 Cr [E35]. Despite these challenges, the company benefits from a favorable sector tailwind in Capital Goods, providing a supportive macro backdrop for its operations [E63, E65].
